newsitem.title: USA: Orbital wins contract with $400 mln possible value.
newsitem.headline: Orbital wins contract with $400 mln possible value.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Corp said Tuesday it was selected by Mobile Communications Holdings Inc for a contract with a potential value of more than $400 million.
The company said it was selected to act as the prime contractor for the development and manufacture of 17 satellites for the Ellipso "Big LEO" worldwide communications system.
As part of a agreement, Orbital will design, develop, construct and test the Ellipso satellites.
The company said total contract value, which includes satellite manufacturing, as well as possible roles in launch services and terminal hand-set manufacturing, could exceed $400 million.
The 17 satellites are planned to be delivered over the next several years.

The company said Mobile's Communications's Ellipso system will allow users to receive and transmit high-quality digital voice and fax communications from telecommunications equipment at very low access and usage costs.
The company said Mobile expects to launch the system in 2000, with initial service later that year.
